scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
